messages:
elena: Hey team — customer (Acme Corp) just opened a ticket saying their tenant-level latency view no longer shows p95/p99 lines after the deploy 20m ago. Only mean/median series are visible. Screenshot attached: <link to screenshot>
mike_oncall: Thanks. Can you paste repro steps and confirm tenant/org view vs global? Is this only for Acme or more tenants?
elena: Repro steps: 1) Console -> Observability -> Latency Insights 2) Select Tenant = Acme Corp 3) Time range = Last 1h 4) Group by route or leave default -> p95 & p99 lines are missing. On global org view the lines appear. So looks tenant-scoped.
deploy-bot: Completed deploy: telemetry-transformer v2.3.1 to canary -> 2024-10-26T15:02Z. Release notes: "compact percentile serialization". CI: green.
sam_platform: tagging eng-platform here — I'm seeing similar reports from two other tenants (internal test org and BetaCorp). Likely not isolated. elena: customer flagged SLA impact -> they're using percentile tails for alerting :grimacing:
tanvi: @mike_oncall assigning to SRE. Mike, any quick checks we can run?
mike_oncall: First check: query raw series from the metrics backend for that tenant. Can you run this in Grafana Explore (metrics-store PromQL):

```
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_bucket{tenant="acme"}[5m])) by (le, route, stat))
```

and then list label keys for series.
sam_platform: Ran a label scan across recent ingests for tenant=acme. Previously we had label key `stat="percentile"` (values p95/p99). After the canary, series show `stat="p"` and a new label `q=0.95` was added. So frontend panels that filter for "stat=percentile" return nothing for tenant-level queries.
elena: so backend changed schema; makes sense why tenant view (which filters by stat label) goes blank.
mike_oncall: Good find. Can you paste the exact output? sam_platform: snippet:

```
# before
route="/v1/generate", tenant="acme", stat="percentile", quantile="0.95"
# after
route="/v1/generate", tenant="acme", stat="p", q="0.95"
```

mike_oncall: That matches the deploy-bot note about compact serialization. Frontend still expects `stat=percentile` and `quantile` label. Two short-term options: 1) revert the transformer canary, or 2) make the query tolerant to both label shapes (update frontend dashboards / query layer to accept `stat=p` or `q` labels).
tanvi: Prioritize minimal customer impact. Elena, can you ask Acme to switch the dashboard to Org-level view (workaround) and confirm alerts? That will surface the series because global view currently uses a different query path.
elena: pinged Acme support contact — they can switch to org-view but would prefer fix. I'm escalating to SE team. They've already opened TICKET-7891 with priority P2.
mike_oncall: I'll push a quick dashboard patch that ORs the labels in the query for tenant views and cut a hotfix. Sample PromQL adjustment Sam, does this look right?

```
# match either old or new label shapes
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_bucket{tenant="acme", (stat="percentile" or stat="p")}[5m])) by (le, route))
```

sam_platform: That will work for a patch. Long-term we should standardize the labels in the ingestion pipeline and coordinate a migration window.
tanvi: Creating an internal PR to accept both shapes and tagging eng-telemetry for schema rollback discussion. Also adding an automated test to detect label key changes in canary.

(20m pass)
elena: Update: Acme toggled to Org view and confirms p95/p99 visible again, alerts are muted for now. They appreciate the quick workaround :relieved:
mike_oncall: Patch PR opened and canary applied to dashboards in staging. If no regressions in 10m we'll roll to prod dashboards and then update docs.
sam_platform: Noted — I've also filed ENG-TELEMETRY-312 to revert the compact serialization or publish a migration plan. Tagging telemetry oncall.

(end)
